tasks.short: Consult on where displays should stand

steps.what: Open the placement question and the plan
Consult buyers on placement of displays
Determine the placement and write it down

tasks.design: The question and the plan are opened from {DOCS}. Consulting store managers, buyers, sales associates, housekeeping, or engineering stays a conversation. The displayer determines the placement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Placement was agreed in a corridor and then disputed.
tasks.enabler_now: The question and the plan can be opened before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: The right place for a display is still decided by the people who run the floor.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows a housekeeping constraint the plan omits.
tasks.altitude: The conversation starts from the plan. The placement is still decided by people.

evidence.claim: Opening a plan is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a placement has to be agreed and ends when the displayer writes the placement.
A plan has a display id and a floor reference, produced by the last sketch. A constraint that is only spoken is written by the displayer and is not inferred.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Who must be consulted before a display is placed.
research_questions: Are housekeeping and engineering on the same plan?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when there is no plan. The consultation stays a conversation. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain props and mannequins in person

steps.what: List props and mannequins due for a look
Note coatings and touch work still due

tasks.design: Props, products, and mannequins due for a look are listed from {ERP}. Inspecting imperfections, touch-ups, cleaning after customers, and preservative coatings stay in the hands.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition was remembered, not recorded, so the same scuff was found twice.
tasks.enabler_now: A prop can be listed with the date it was last looked at.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing an imperfection and repairing it is physical.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows a coating that would damage that surface.
tasks.altitude: The due list is current. The inspection and the repair stay in the hands.

reach.task: See which props are not fit to show

steps.what: Open the season brief and the window size
Keep one plan and drop the rest

tasks.design: The season brief and the window size are opened from {DOCS}. Developing ideas and plans for merchandise displays or window decorations stays with the displayer. A brief is not an idea, and no image is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ideas were sketched on scrap and could not be found later.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief and the measured window can be opened first.
tasks.still_hard: The idea itself is the displayer's.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows what this window has held and what failed.
tasks.altitude: The brief is open. The idea is still developed by the displayer.

evidence.claim: A brief is a record. It does not develop the idea. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a season or a window is to be planned and ends when the displayer keeps one plan.
A brief has a window id, a width, a height, and a season, produced by the store. The screen does not generate a decoration.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
research_questions: Who picks the idea that will be built?

tasks.short: Assemble displays in the store space

steps.what: Open the sketch and the accessory list
Assemble displays with lights in the store
Note pictures or colors that were not used

tasks.design: The sketch and the accessory list are opened from {DOCS}. Assembling displays, furniture, or products in the store, with colors, lights, and pictures, stays physical.
tasks.previous_blocker: Accessory lists did not match the sketch on the day.
tasks.enabler_now: The sketch and the list can be opened in the space.
tasks.still_hard: Assembly is physical work with the actual pieces.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer sees a light that the sketch places where it will not fit.
tasks.altitude: The list is in the space. Assembly stays in the hands.

evidence.claim: A list is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a display is to be set up and ends when it is assembled.
A sketch has a display id. An accessory has an item id, produced by the sketch. An item not on the list is not treated as part of the display.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether lights and pictures are named on the sketch.

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the sketch is paper. Assembly stays physical. The range is below that case.

role.altitude: Consultations and the idea stay with the displayer. Props are inspected in person. Assembly uses the sketch and stays physical. No image is generated.
reach: A buyer sees the placement the displayer wrote.
A scuffed prop is noted, not hidden.
skills_to_grow: Do not infer a constraint that was only going to be spoken.
Do not mark a prop inspected if it was not looked at.
role.ambitious_version: The owned props are listed before the idea is chosen, and the idea is still the displayer's.
